tools.name: exact_math
tools.description: Exact rational arithmetic and one-variable linear equations. Supports implicit multiplication. Rational constants support integer powers with ^ or **, including negative exponents (absolute exponent <=4096). Powers bind before unary minus and associate right. Zero to zero/negative powers, fractional/variable exponents and nonlinear variable powers are rejected. No variable denominators. Independently checks substitution and affine conditions. format=latex accepts a strict subset: fractions, square roots, powers, braced functions; unsupported or ambiguous input is rejected. Scientific notation is exact. floor/ceil/truncate take expression; mod/compare require other. mod=a-b*floor(a/b), compare returns -1/0/1. round accepts digits (-100..100), rounding=half_even (default) or half_away_from_zero. Supply exactly one of expression or ir; MathIR can be reused directly without reparsing display text.

tools.name: symbolic_math
tools.description: Symbolic algebra/calculus using SymPy. Explicit multiplication; powers use ^ or **. Operations: simplify, expand, factor, solve ONE variable equation, differentiate, integrate (optional finite interval), limit. Declare real/complex domain. Does not execute code. Exact integration endpoints accept strings such as 1/3 or pi; use strings to preserve decimal precision. format=latex accepts a strict subset: fractions, square roots, powers, braced functions; unsupported or ambiguous input is rejected. Supply exactly one of expression or ir; MathIR can be reused directly without reparsing display text.

tools.name: numeric_math
tools.description: Floating-point numerical calculation. root requires a continuous function with a sign-changing interval; integrate uses finite bounds; minimize is bounded LOCAL minimization, not a global proof. linear_solve needs square matrix and vector; eigenvalues needs square matrix. Explicit multiplication. Precision specifies absolute/relative tolerances and iteration budget; mutually exclusive with tolerance. Only standard binary64 is currently supported; requested tolerances are not certified error bounds. roots isolates all real polynomial roots (multiplicity and exact intervals), otherwise returns an incomplete scan plus unresolved intervals. system_root takes expressions, variables and initialGuess and returns one local candidate, never all solutions.

tools.name: plot_math
tools.description: Render a PNG chart directly in the answer. function: expression or expressions and interval. scatter/line/regression: attached datasetId, xColumn, yColumn. histogram: datasetId and xColumn. Missing/non-numeric rows require explicit missingPolicy=drop to exclude.

tools.name: analyze_data
tools.description: Analyze an ATTACHED CSV/TSV dataset. overview reports schema/missing values. describe/correlation take numeric columns; regression takes [predictor,response]; group_by takes groupColumn, numeric columns and aggregate. filter uses typed filters. Use missingPolicy=drop only when exclusion is appropriate and disclose it. Tables appear directly in answer.

tools.name: convex_optimize
tools.description: Convex optimization with CVXPY/CLARABEL. LP: minimize linear^T x. QP: minimize 0.5*x^T quadratic*x + linear^T*x; quadratic must be symmetric PSD. Least squares: minimize ||design*x-target||^2, optional linear term. Constraints: inequalityMatrix*x<=inequalityBounds, equalityMatrix*x=equalityBounds, finite lower/upper. SOC: each cone imposes ||matrix*x+offset||_2 <= axis^T*x+bound. Returns solver status, primal/dual values and feasibility residuals; numerical optimization is not a formal proof. Precision specifies absolute/relative tolerances and iteration budget; mutually exclusive with tolerance. Only standard binary64 is currently supported; requested tolerances are not certified error bounds. Also checks available numerical KKT conditions; definite infeasible/unbounded LP statuses trigger a bounded witness search accepted only after exact rational verification.

tools.name: structure_math
tools.description: Parse exactly one expression or MathIR object. Returns irVersion=1, lossless syntax, normalized preview and original domain restrictions. LaTeX subset: frac, sqrt, powers, single-letter/subscripted variables, braced functions, matrix/pmatrix/bmatrix. Unknown macros, indexed roots, bare function arguments and partial input are rejected. MathIR number values are strings; nodes include Integer, Rational, DecimalLiteral, Symbol, arithmetic, Equation, Matrix, Algebraic and sets.

tools.name: algebra_math
tools.description: Exact radicals, real algebraic constants and polynomials. Binary operations require other. Algebraic outputs identify increasing real roots of an integer minimal polynomial with rational isolating intervals; degree <=16. Polynomials declare variables (default [x]), coefficientDomain QQ/ZZ; degree <=20, terms <=200. divide returns quotient/remainder; gcd, factor, square_free, resultant and all-real-root isolate_roots are supported. Resultants are elimination constraints, not complete equation solutions. Supply exactly one of expression or ir; MathIR can be reused directly without reparsing display text.

tools.name: set_math
tools.description: Exact MathIR set operations. FiniteSet uses elements of real constant MathIR nodes. Interval uses start/end MathIR nodes or -inf/inf strings plus leftOpen/rightOpen booleans. Universe name is Reals or Integers. Union/Intersection/Complement nodes use two args. complement requires explicit universe and provable containment. Binary union/intersection/difference require other. Infinite endpoints must be open.

tools.name: equation_math
tools.description: Exact real equations with original-domain checks. single solves one equation. linear_system supports exact systems and one real rational-function parameter with at most 3 rows/unknowns; returns generic and exceptional parameter branches. polynomial_system handles bounded zero-dimensional QQ systems (3 unknowns, degree 4); positive-dimensional or unrepresented cases remain unresolved. inequalities handles one real variable with explicit relation records. Completeness and candidate verification are distinct.

tools.name: matrix_math
tools.description: Exact real algebraic matrices (strings/integers, at most 12x12): determinant, rank, inverse, nullspace, solve with free parameters, quadratic-form inertia. Numeric QR/SVD/least_squares/solve report residuals and conditioning. Sparse COO square solve uses GMRES without densification. Default mode is numeric for qr/svd/least_squares/sparse_solve and exact otherwise; JSON floats are rejected in exact mode.

tools.name: calculus_math
tools.description: Multivariable partials, gradient, Jacobian, Hessian, implicit derivative for [independent,dependent]. Optional verifyAt provides a local finite-difference heuristic. integrate limits follow variables IN INNERMOST-TO-OUTERMOST ORDER; bounds may depend only on later variables, inf/-inf accepted. Symbolic improper/multiple integration separates interior singularities when enumerable. piecewise_integrate takes ordered disjoint segments; sums those segments only. Numeric integration supports one dimension, reports estimated error and unknown convergence, not a principal value or strict bound.

tools.name: convex_model
tools.description: Named continuous convex modeling. Expression nodes: constant(value), variable(name), parameter(name); binary add/subtract/multiply/matmul/quad_form(args); unary negate/sum/max/abs/sum_squares/norm(args, optional order 1/2/inf), index(args,index). One operand of products must be constant. Explicit shapes; <=/>=/= constraints. CLARABEL via CVXPY DCP canonicalization. Returns named primal/dual values, FULL original objective including constants, per-constraint residuals and available numerical KKT checks. Unknown atoms and non-DCP models are rejected; no integer variables.
